result.stdout:
omnicore-mcp: a Model Context Protocol server (stdio) for an OmniCore database.

Signs in with occtl's saved sign-in: run `occtl login <server-url>` first.

Options:
  --context <name>   The occtl context to use (default: occtl's current context). Env: OMNICORE_MCP_CONTEXT
  --allow-writes     Also offer tools that change data and schema. Env: OMNICORE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=true
  --max-rows <n>     Most entities or rows per tool call (default 100).
  --max-chars <n>    Most characters of JSON per tool call (default 40000).
  --version          Print the version.
